newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Advance says early merger support.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Advance says early merger support.

text.p: Advance Bank Australia Ltd said on Monday that the early count from its poll of shareholders showed that 81 percent supported the merger with St George Bank Ltd.
Advance chairman Jim Service said of the 34,118 votes counted at the Monday meeting, 26,526 were in favour.
The official result will be released at 1.15 p.m. (0215 GMT).
The 629 shareholders at the meeting were voting on the plan by the Sydney-based regional bank to merge with St George in a cash and share swap deal which values Advance at A$2.65 billion.
